info.name: Online Book Store API
info.description:
API tests for the Online Book Store System (Software Testing course project).

Before running: start the backend (`cd app/backend && npm run seed && npm run dev`).
The tests expect freshly seeded data, so run `npm run seed` before each full run.

Run from the command line: `postman collection run app/postman/OnlineBookStore.postman_collection.json`
or with Newman: `npx newman run app/postman/OnlineBookStore.postman_collection.json`.

Every request checks the status code and the exact message from the CLAUDE.md contract.

item.name: F2 Search books
item.description: Title search, category filter and book details. Open to guests.

exec: pm.test("30 books returned", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.books).to.have.lengthOf(30); });
pm.test("query trimmed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.query).to.eql('harbor'); });
pm.test("found The Silent Harbor", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.books[0].title).to.eql('The Silent Harbor'); });
pm.test("all Science", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); b.books.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.category).to.eql('Science')); });

pm.test("In stock / Only N left / Out of stock all present", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); const s = b.books.map((x) => x.stockStatus); ['In stock', 'Only 1 left', 'Out of stock'].forEach((l) => pm.expect(s).to.include(l)); });

pm.test('Message: ' + "No books found matching \"zzz\". Try a different title or category.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("No books found matching \"zzz\". Try a different title or category."));
pm.test("empty list", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.books).to.have.lengthOf(0); });

item.name: F5 Order history
item.description: Order list and details; users only see their own orders.

exec: pm.test('Error message: ' + "Please log in to continue.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("Please log in to continue."));
pm.test("newest is the order just placed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.orders[0].orderNo).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('lastOrderNo')); });
pm.test("sorted newest first", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); const d = b.orders.map((o) => o.createdAt); pm.expect(d).to.eql([...d].sort().reverse()); });

pm.test("seed statuses present", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); const s = b.orders.map((o) => o.status); ['Delivered', 'Shipped', 'Cancelled', 'Placed'].forEach((x) => pm.expect(s).to.include(x)); });

pm.test("has items, shipping and total", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.order.items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b.order.shipping.fullName).to.eql("Alice Johnson"); pm.expect(b.order.total).to.eql(11.98); });
pm.test('Error message: ' + "Order not found.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("Order not found."));
pm.test('Error message: ' + "Order not found.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("Order not found."));
